status: isolated candidate, not Source integrated, installed or released
problem: serde_json RawValue validates syntax without decoding out-of-range numbers or invalid Unicode escapes. Building a BTreeMap of borrowed RawValues before validating values drops earlier duplicate keys, incorrectly accepting e.g. {"x":1e400,"x":1} and {"x":"\ud800","x":1}, while serde_json Value rejects them.
change: Decode object entries in input order with serde_json stream deserializers, keep all duplicate value nodes in the iterative worklist, retain last decoded key in BTreeMap and retire replaced nodes after their descendants have been validated. No new Lib-local limits or compiler changes.

Additional focused duplicate controls passed after adding surrogate test.
